summary: Powell Max Ltd filed a 6-K reporting a best-efforts private placement under a Securities Purchase Agreement dated August 20, 2026, with accredited investors. The company may sell Class C ordinary shares at $1.00 per share for up to approximately $4,000,000 gross. A first closing on August 24, 2026 raised $1,700,000 via 1,700,000 shares to two purchasers; Spartan Capital Securities serves as exclusive placement agent, earning 10% cash fees plus 10% warrant coverage. Class C shares convert into Class A shares subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap, with the offering period ending December 31, 2026. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
